detail.title: KM1410 Gaming Keyboard & Mouse Combo - Carbon Black
detail.overview: The Ant Esports KM1410 pairs a 25-key RGB LED backlit membrane keyboard section with an ergonomic gaming mouse offering up to 3600 DPI, delivering responsive performance, vibrant lighting and long-lasting durability in one affordable combo. Full anti-ghosting on the keyboard ensures accurate multi-key input during intense gaming, while a water-resistant membrane design guards against everyday spills. The included mouse offers smooth tracking and comfortable ergonomics well suited to newcomers entering PC gaming, and true plug-and-play USB connectivity means both devices work instantly with no drivers required. A stylish, entry-level combo for competitive games, work projects and everyday entertainment alike.
